state.review_type: change-triggered review of EU AI Act Article 50 transparency obligations
systems_in_scope: every AI system recorded in the AI-system register as at as_of

decisions.summary: Stage 01 declares the scope as a rule and does not enumerate the systems.
decisions.rationale: The systems live in the AI-system register, which is fetched in stage 02. Enumerating them here would mean carrying a copied list that says nothing about the register as it is today.
tradeoffs: A reviewer does not see the eight system ids until stage 04.
The scope rule is stable while the register changes.
